ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 5:95 high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black field with sparse, high-intensity circular and sub-circular pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) distributed semi-randomly across both lobes, with a higher density of white speckling near the median notch and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45-50 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 15% into the fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys of 3-10 pixels) along the entire trailing edge, with more pronounced jaggedness observed on the terminal outer margins compared to the interior notch region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to a steep upward convexity at the distal tips, resulting in a tapered, wing-like 2D projection.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white clusters (rosettes) concentrated primarily on the lower half of the right lobe and scattered across the central region of the left lobe, consistent with pixel patterns of healed barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, nearly vertical high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) localized on the upper-left quadrant of the left fluke lobe, breaking the solid dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, high-intensity textured clusters of calcified growths (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; the left tip exhibits a larger, more irregular mass compared to the right.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible presence of a secondary dark aquatic appendage (dorsal fin or fluke of another individual) in the lower-left foreground, partially occluded by water.
